snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI.

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com.

Listen to “Flower in a Hurricane” now: https://justice.lnk.to/flowerinahurricane

This trailer was captured entirely in-game from a PlayStation 5.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

Lyrics 

Agar…khuda ne, banaaya hai dard,
Toh koi hamdard bhi banaaya hoga!!
Agar…likha qismato’n me safar,
Toh koi hamsafar bhi aaya hoga!!

Khol dil ke dar, dahleez par, ishq ko aane de!
Do din ki zindagi mein, sau saal waali mohabbat…ho jaane de!
___________ 

Antra: 1
Ik din poochha us khuda se!
Kahte hain tere aasma’n pe!
Hota hai faisla, dil ke, rishto’n ka! 

Phir maanga maine yeh dua mein!
De de ik dil tere jahaa’n se!
Chupke se de diya, rab ne, tera pata! 

Bhool saare gham, jee uthe hain hum, tujhko hi paane se!
Do din ki zindagi mein, sau saal waali mohabbat…ho jaane de!

Agar…rab ne banaaya hai dil,
Toh koi dilbar bhi banaaya hoga!
Agar…likha qismato’n me hai gham,
Toh koi hamdam bhi aaya hoga! 


ANTRA: 2  
 Yaara maine tujhe chaaha nahin tha,
Par dhoop kinaara yahi tha, 
Aaya tu aise ik din, diiil ki…basti mein!

 Aasuo’n se tune naam likha tha,
Tera hona mera kaam likha tha,
Ban baithe hum toh raahi teri…kashti ke!

Thi joh aankh nam, mit gaye woh gham, ik tere hi aane se!
Do din ki zindagi mein, sau saal waali mohabbat…ho jaane de!

snippet.description:
Ganga Devotional presents  छठा नवरात्र स्पेशल - दरबार तेरा भक्तों ने सजाया है, कात्यायनी माता की कथा, ये गोटेदार चुनरी आजा माँ ओढ़ के, मैया ऊँचे भवन विराजो, देख के श्रृंगार माँ का, दुर्गे भवानी नमो नमः, लाल फूलों की आई है बहार, मैं नहीं थकता माँ जयकारा बोल के 

जय माता दी! 🌺🚩 शारदीय नवरात्रि 2026 के इस पावन अवसर पर सुनिए माता रानी के सबसे सुंदर, मधुर और भक्तिमय भजनों का विशेष संग्रह। माँ दुर्गा की महिमा, माँ अम्बे की भक्ति और माता रानी के दिव्य भजनों से अपने मन को भक्ति और सकारात्मक ऊर्जा से भर दीजिए।

इस *Top 10 Shardiya Navratri Bhajan 2026* संग्रह में आपको सुनने को मिलेंगे माता रानी के लोकप्रिय भजन, दुर्गा माँ के मधुर देवी गीत, नवरात्रि स्पेशल भजन और Nonstop Mata Rani Bhajan, जो नवरात्रि पूजा, सुबह की आराधना, माता की चौकी, जागरण और घर में भक्ति का वातावरण बनाने के लिए उपयुक्त हैं। 🌸🙏

माँ दुर्गा की कृपा से सभी भक्तों के जीवन में सुख, शांति, समृद्धि और खुशहाली बनी रहे। नवरात्रि के इन पावन दिनों में माँ के चरणों में अपनी श्रद्धा अर्पित करें और प्रेम से बोलें — *जय माता दी! जय अम्बे गौरी!* 🚩🔱

snippet.description:
যে গান গুলি ছাড়া পুজো অসম্পূর্ণ | Best Durga Puja Songs | Old Bengali Songs | Kishore - Asha - Lata
Enjoy old Bengali songs by Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle and Lata Mangeshkar in this Durga Puja audio jukebox.
Revisit Pujor Gaan and familiar Bengali favourites that make your festive listening feel complete.
Listen to the collection and share the song that brings back your favourite Puja memory.

“Je Gaan Guli Chhara Pujo Asampurno”—songs without which Puja feels incomplete—is the theme of this collection. Celebrate the season with the voices of Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle and Lata Mangeshkar, and return to the Bengali songs you associate with festive days.

Whether you are spending time with family, meeting old friends or enjoying a quiet musical evening, explore this selection of old Bengali songs. For listeners who love Pujor Purono Gaan, Swarnajuger Gaan and evergreen Bengali music, enjoy the complete audio jukebox here.

Which song makes your Puja feel complete? Leave its title or timestamp in the comments.

Like the video, save the collection to your Bengali music playlist and share it with someone who loves classic Bangla songs.

Subscribe for more Bengali classics, artist collections and audio jukeboxes.
